_doc: Escape-introducing sites that audit_instrumentation.py finds no nearby record() for, but which ARE covered by a mechanism proximity cannot see. Every entry needs a justification that can be re-checked. A site not listed here and not proximate is a real finding.

sites.why: PROXIMITY WINDOW ONLY. THREAD_REACHABLE_CLASS is recorded at line 67, 14 lines away, because the reason must be stamped after the ObjectNode exists - on the no-BCI path the object identity changes to the InvalidBCIObjectNode singleton. Genuinely covered.

COPIES AN EXISTING VERDICT. Writes Escape into solvedSummaries only when the incoming state is already Escape, i.e. a handler put it there and recorded a reason against the same (method, object) key. Introduces no new escape.

COVERED BY collectReasons. resolve() short-circuits at the first firing condition; collectReasons is its non-short-circuiting twin and runs immediately before it for the same component, evaluating all four conditions for every member. Attribution is by that pass, not by proximity.

DEAD ON THIS PATH. Main.java sets useNewResolver = true unconditionally, and printReasons is only called in the ReworkedResolver branch, so no run that produces a .reasons file reaches SummaryResolver at all.
